name: omitly-mcp
description: Model Context Protocol server exposing Omitly's local, verifiable PDF redaction to AI agents. Redaction runs on-device — documents are never uploaded. Licence: omitly.app/eula.

scripts.test: tsc && npm run build:view && node --test --test-skip-pattern="(v2-produced file|v2 verdict that disagrees|DECISION_CHANNELS is the shared vectors|surfaces decisionChannel only when verified|probe_1890_enqueue_hashes_nothing|T18: only outcome|E1: a sidecar verify reply|E2: a sidecar that makes|E4: previews the file controls|E5: each closed engine|E6: a real-sized page list|every document tool, with a hostile|G1: check_redaction|G3: verify_redaction|G5: the real off-page|C3: a scan that does not|V1: ANY information|V2: region, survivor|E9a: every hostile|E9b: every string field|Z2: previews, kinds)" "dist/**/*.test.js"
scripts.mcpb:prep: node mcpb/scripts/copy-wasm.mjs && cp LICENSE mcpb/LICENSE && npm --prefix mcpb ci
scripts.mcpb:pack: npm run mcpb:prep && npm run mcpb:validate && mkdir -p dist-mcpb && npx -y @anthropic-ai/mcpb@2.1.2 pack mcpb dist-mcpb/omitly-leak-check.mcpb
